arabic_text: وَتَمِّمْ سُبُوغَ نِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَظَاهِرْ كَرَامَاتِهَا لَدَيَّ، و امْلاْ مِنْ فَوَائِدِكَ يَدَيَّ، وَسُقْ كَرَائِمَ مَوَاهِبِكَ إلَيَّ، وَجَاوِرْ بِيَ الاَطْيَبِينَ مِنْ أَوْلِيَآئِكَ فِي الْجِنَاْنِ الَّتِي زَيَّنْتَهَا لاَِصْفِيآئِكَ،
transliteration: wa tamim subugh ni'matika 'alayya, wa thahir karamatihā ladayya wa amla min fawāʾidika yadayya, wa suq karāʾima mawāhibika ilayya wa jāwir biya al-aṭyabīna min awliyā'ika fi al-jināni allatī zayyanta-hā la-iṣfiyā'ika
english_text: Complete the lavishness of Thy favour upon me, clothe me in its repeated generosities, fill my hand with Thy benefits, drive Thy generous gifts to me, make me the neighbour of the best of Thy friends in the Gardens which Thou hast adorned for Thy chosen

arabic_text: وَجَلِّلْنِي شَرَآئِفَ نِحَلِكَ فِي الْمَقَامَاتِ الْمُعَدَّةِ لاَِحِبَّائِكَ،
transliteration: wajallilnī sharāʾifan niḥalika fī al-maqāmāt al-muʿaddati li-ahibbāʾik
english_text: and wrap me in Thy noble presents in the stations prepared for Thy beloveds!

arabic_text: وَاجْعَلْ لِيَ عِنْدَكَ مَقِيْلاً آوِي إلَيْهِ مُطْمَئِنّاً، وَمَثابَةً أَتَبَوَّأُهَا وَأَقَرُّ عَيْناً.
transliteration: wa-j'al liya ʿindaka maqīlan ʾāwi ilayhi muṭmaʾinnan wa mathābatan atabawwa'uha wa aqarru ʿaynan
english_text: Appoint for me a resting place with Thee where I may seek haven in serenity, and a resort to which I may revert and rest my eyes,

arabic_text: وَلاَ تُقَايِسْنِي بِعَظِيمَاتِ الْجَرَائِرِ، وَلاَ تُهْلِكْنِي يَوْمَ تُبْلَى السَّرَائِرُ، وَأَزِلْ عَنِّي كُلَّ شَكٍّ وَشُبْهَة، وَاجْعَلْ لِي فِي الْحَقِّ طَرِيقاً مِنْ كُلِّ رَحْمَة،
transliteration: walā tuqāyisnī biʿaẓīmāt al-jarāʾir wa lā tuhliknī yawma tublā al-sarā'iru wa azil ʿanni kulla shakkin wa shubhah wa-jaʿal li fil-ḥaqqi ṭarīqan min kulli raḥmah
english_text: weigh not against me my dreadful misdeeds, destroy me not on "the day the secrets are tried" (86:9), eliminate from me every doubt and uncertainty, appoint for me a way in the truth from every mercy,

arabic_text: وأَجْزِلْ لِي قِسَمَ الْمَواهِبِ مِنْ نَوَالِكَ، وَوَفِّرْ عَلَيَّ حُظُوظَ الاِحْسَانِ مِنْ إفْضَالِكَ،
transliteration: wa ajzil li qisma al-mawahibi min nawalika wa waffir ʿalayya ḥuẓūẓa al-iḥsāni min ifḍālik
english_text: make plentiful for me the portions of gifts from Thy granting of awards, and fill out for me the shares of beneficence from Thy bestowal of bounty!

arabic_text: وَاجْعَلْ قَلْبِي وَاثِقاً بِمَا عِنْدَكَ، وَهَمِّيَ مُسْتَفْرَغاً لِمَا هُوَ لَكَ، وَاسْتَعْمِلْنِي بِما تَسْتَعْمِلُ بِهِ خَالِصَتَكَ، وَأَشْرِبْ قَلْبِي عِنْدَ ذُهُولِ العُقُولِ طَاعَتَكَ،
transliteration: wajʿal qalbī wāthiqan bimā ʿindak wa hammīya mustafraġan limā huwa laka wa astaʿmilnī bimā tastaʿmilu bihi khāliṣatika wa-ashrib qalbi 'indadhuwli-l-'uquul taa'atak
english_text: Make my heart trust in what is with Thee and my concern free for what is Thine, employ me in that in which Thou employest Thy pure friends, drench my heart with Thy obedience when intellects are distracted,

arabic_text: وَاجْمَعْ لِي الْغِنى، وَالْعَفَافَ، وَالدَّعَةَ، وَالْمُعَافَاةَ، وَالصِّحَّةَ، وَالسَّعَةَ، وَالطُّمَأْنِيْنَةَ، وَالْعَافِيَةَ،
transliteration: waajma' li al-ghinā, wal-'afāf, wadda'ah, wal-mu'āfāh wal-ṣiḥḥah, was-saʿah, waṭ-ṭumaniinah, wal-ʿaafiyah
english_text: and combine within me independence, continence, ease, release, health, plenty, tranquillity, and well being!

arabic_text: وَلاَ تُحْبِطْ حَسَنَاتِي بِمَا يَشُوبُهَا مِنْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ، وَلاَ خَلَواتِي بِمَا يَعْرِضُ لِيَ مِنْ نَزَغَاتِ فِتْنَتِكَ،
transliteration: walā tuḥbiṭ ḥasanātī bimā yashūbuha min maʿṣiyatika walā khalawātī bimā yaʿriḍu liya min nazaghāti fitnatika
english_text: Make not fail my good deeds through my disobedience that stains them or my private times of worship through the instigations of Thy trial!

arabic_text: وَصُنْ وَجْهِي عَنِ الطَّلَبِ إلَى أَحَد مِنَ الْعَالَمِينَ، وَذُبَّنِي عَنِ التِماسِ مَا عِنْدَ الفَاسِقِينَ،
transliteration: waṣun wajhī ʿani aṭ-ṭalabi ilá ʾaḥad min al-ʿālamīn wa thubbanī ʿani atimāsi mā ʿinda al-fāsiqīn
english_text: Safeguard my face from asking from anyone in the world, and drive me far from begging for that which is with the ungodly!

arabic_text: وَلاَ تَجْعَلْنِي لِلظَّالِمِينَ ظَهِيراً، وَلاَ لَهُمْ عَلى مَحْوِ كِتَابِكَ يَداً وَنَصِيراً،
transliteration: walā tajʿalnī liẓ-ẓālimīna ẓahīran walā lahūm ʿalā maḥwī kitābika yadān wa naṣīrā
english_text: Make me not an aid to the wrongdoers, nor their hand and helper in erasing Thy Book!

arabic_text: وَحُطْنِي مِنْ حَيْثُ لاَ أَعْلَمُ حِيَاطَةً تَقِيْنِي بِهَا،
transliteration: waḥuṭnī min ḥaythu lā aʿlamu ḥiyāṭatan taqīnī bihā
english_text: Defend me whence I know not with a defense through which Thou protectest me!

arabic_text: وَافْتَحْ لِيَ أَبْوَابَ تَوْبَتِكَ وَرَحْمَتِكَ وَرَأْفَتِكَ وَرِزْقِكَ الواسِعِ،
transliteration: wa-iftaḥ liya abwāba tawbatika wa raḥmatika wa raʾfatika wa rizqika al-wāsiʿi
english_text: Open toward me the gates of Thy repentance, Thy mercy, Thy clemency, and Thy boundless provision!
Surely I am one of those who beseech Thee!

arabic_text: وَأَتْمِمْ لِي إنْعَامَكَ، إنَّكَ خَيْرُ الْمُنْعِمِيْنَ،
transliteration: wa'tmim li inʿāmak, innaka khayru almunʿimīn
english_text: And complete Thy favour toward me! Surely Thou art the best of those who show favour!

arabic_text: وَاجْعَلْ باقِيَ عُمْرِيْ فِي الْحَجِّ وَالْعُمْرَةِ ابْتِغَآءَ وَجْهِكَ يَاربَّ الْعَالَمِينَ،
transliteration: wa-jʿal bāqiya ʿumrī fī al-ḥajj wa-al-ʿumrah ibtighāʾa wajhika yā rabba al-ʿālamīn
english_text: Place the rest of my life in the hajj and the 'umra seeking Thy face, O Lord of the worlds!

arabic_text: وَصَلَّى اللهُ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ الطَّيِّبِينَ الطَّاهِرِينَ، وَالسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَيْهِمْ أَبَدَ الابِدِينَ.
transliteration: wa ṣalla allāhu ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihi al-ṭṭayyibīna al-ṭāhirīn wa al-salāmu ʿalayhi wa ʿalayhim abada al-abidiin
english_text: And may God bless Muhammad and his Household, the good, the pure, and peace be upon him and them always and forever!
